# Technical Guide: Adding a New Benchmark to an Optimization Repository

This guide outlines the standard procedure for integrating a new benchmark into our optimization infrastructure. Adherence to these conventions ensures reproducibility, comparability, and long-term maintainability.

## 1. Directory Structure & File Placement

All new benchmarks must follow the standard layout below. Replace `<benchmark_name>` with a unique, lowercase, snake_case identifier (e.g., `matrix_mult_avx512`).

```
benchmarks/
└── <benchmark_name>/
    ├── README.md              # Benchmark-specific documentation
    ├── src/                   # Source code
